GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 01 January 2026
Showery condition is expected to enhance in Eastern, Northern and Uva provinces during the coming
days, due to the development of a low-level atmospheric disturbance to the East of Sri Lanka.
Showers will occur at times in Eastern, Central, North-central and Uva provinces. Fairly heavy falls
above 50 mm are likely at some places in Central and Uva provinces and in Batticaloa and Ampara
districts.
Several spells of showers will occur in Northern province.
Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places elsewhere after 2.00 p.m.
A few showers may occur in coastal areas of North-western and Western provinces.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Sabaragamuwa and Central provinces and in Galle
and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by
temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
